Geometry: Cylindrical combustion chamber, length 0.2 m, diameter 0.1 m. Simulated in 2D axisymmetric (r-x plane), axis at r=0. Mesh is structured block mesh with 100 cells axially and 50 cells radially. Mesh is refined (finer grading) near the axis (r=0) and near the injector location at the inlet.

Solver: reactingParcelFoam. Lagrangian parcel tracking for liquid dodecane droplets coupled with Eulerian gas-phase transport and combustion.

Boundary conditions at inlet (left face, axial direction): velocity-inlet type. U = (10, 0, 0) m/s. T = 800 K fixed. p = 101325 Pa fixed. Species mass fractions: Y_O2 = 0.233, Y_N2 = 0.767. Turbulence: k = 0.094 m2/s2 (from I=5%, U=10 m/s), epsilon calculated from k and length scale (recommended L = 0.07*D = 0.007 m, giving epsilon ≈ 0.6 m2/s3). Initial conditions throughout the domain: same species composition and T = 800 K, U = 0 (stagnant hot air), same k and epsilon as inlet. No droplets present at t=0.

Boundary conditions at outlet (right face): p uses totalPressure BC with reference pressure 101325 Pa. U, T, all species Y_i, k, epsilon use zeroGradient.

Boundary conditions at wall (outer radial boundary at r=0.05 m): U uses noSlip. T uses fixedValue 400 K. Species Y_i use zeroGradient. p uses zeroGradient. k uses kqRWallFunction. epsilon uses epsilonWallFunction. nut uses nutWallFunction.

Boundary conditions at axis (inner radial boundary at r=0): boundary type is 'axis'. No additional per-field BC overrides needed; the axis type handles U_n=0 and zeroGradient for scalars automatically.

Spray injection: cone injection model positioned at the center of the inlet face on the axis (r=0, x=0). Fuel is liquid n-dodecane (nC12H26). Mass flow rate = 0.002 kg/s. Droplet temperature at injection = 300 K. Droplet size distribution follows Rosin-Rammler with meanDiameter = 50e-6 m. Heat and mass transfer model is RanzMarshall. Drag model is standard. Cone angle and initial droplet velocity are open parameters (not specified in requirement); select reasonable values (e.g., coneAngle 15-30 degrees, velocity 0 or small value per foam defaults).

Combustion: Two-step global reaction mechanism for dodecane. Thermodynamics use janaf tables. Configuration lives in constant/combustionProperties (combustionModel multiComponent or equivalent) and constant/reactionSchemes (two-step reactions). Specific stoichiometries, Arrhenius pre-exponential factors, activation energies, and turbulence-chemistry interaction model are open parameters not defined in requirement; select from literature (e.g., Westbrook-Dryden or Seshadri style global two-step: partial oxidation to CO+H2O, then CO oxidation to CO2).

Turbulence model: Standard k-epsilon RAS. Wall functions used at the wall (consistent with mesh y+ range 30-100+ for 100x50 mesh). No low-Re correction.

Time control: startTime = 0, endTime = 0.05 s. writeControl = time, writeInterval = 0.001 s (produces approximately 50 output frames). adjustTimeStep = yes, maxCo = 0.7. Initial deltaT, maxDeltaT, and temporal discretization scheme (ddtSchemes) are open parameters; recommended: deltaT ~ 1e-5 s, Euler time scheme. maxDeltaT not specified.

Numerical schemes and solution settings (fvSchemes divSchemes, gradSchemes, laplacianSchemes; fvSolution PIMPLE settings, linear solvers, tolerances) are not specified in the requirement. Use standard reactingParcelFoam defaults: Gauss upwind or linearUpwind for advection of scalars and turbulence quantities, central differencing for Laplacian, PIMPLE with appropriate under-relaxation and pressure-velocity coupling.

Open parameters summary (engineer selects reasonable values, not dictated by requirement): coneAngle, initial droplet velocity, length scale L for epsilon, specific two-step reaction equations and Arrhenius parameters, turbulence-chemistry interaction model, initial deltaT, ddtSchemes choice, mesh grading/expansion ratios, fvSchemes and fvSolution numerical details.
